Senior Data & AI Developer – GCP Platform & Architecture
description:
**Overview**
 We are looking for a Senior Data \& AI Developer to lead the design and implementation of a GCP\-based data and AI platform . This role will drive architecture decisions, build scalable pipelines, and implement AI\-driven monitoring and data quality solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect and implement end\-to\-end data pipelines
* Design and maintain a medallion data architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold)
* Lead development of data transformations using dbt
* Build scalable ELT pipelines using SQL and Python
* Design and operate Lakehouse architecture using open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi)
* Architect and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines
* Apply cost\-aware data modeling and query optimization
* Implement AI/ML solutions for pipeline monitoring and data quality
* Implement AI/ML and GenAI use cases for predictive analytics
* Optimize reporting datasets for BI and analytics consumption
* Design metadata management and data cataloging solutions
* Define standards for data modeling, documentation, and governance
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data workloads
* Mentor junior engineers and set engineering best practices


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**
* 6–10\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics, or AI
* Strong expertise in Google Cloud Platform / AWS ( BigQuery , GCS, Composer, etc.)
* Advanced SQL and Python skills
* Advanced experience using dbt for analytics engineering
* Strong background in data modeling and semantic layer design
* Experience supporting BI tools and executive reporting
* Experience designing data lakes and data warehouses
* Strong understanding of ELT, orchestration, and data integration
* Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices for data platforms
* Experience with surfacing data sets to Agents
* Experience with API\-based data ingestion and data surfacing


**Nice to Have**
* Hands\-on experience with LLMs and GenAI platforms
* Background in enterprise\-scale analytics platforms
* Prior experience leading cloud data modernization programs
